name: epitech-vs-coding-style
description: Real-time Epitech coding style checker (epiclang + Banana) for Visual Studio Code.

scripts.package: bun run build && vsce package --no-dependencies --readme-path docs/README.md --baseContentUrl https://github.com/maty-millien/EpiStyle/blob/HEAD/docs --baseImagesUrl https://github.com/maty-millien/EpiStyle/raw/HEAD/docs

epitech-coding-style.enable.description: Enable or disable the real-time coding style checker.

epitech-coding-style.persistLogFile.description: Keep the .vscode/coding-style-reports.log file after analysis. If disabled, the file is deleted as soon as the analysis finishes.

epitech-coding-style.excludePaths.description: Gitignore-style patterns to exclude from analysis, on top of the workspace .gitignore.
